_comment: Copy this to _offline_test/config.json to get a sandbox that is completely
separate from your real config: its own data/ and results/ directories, and
Fill it once with 'python fetch.py --config _offline_test/config.json' using
real credentials (replace the tokens below, or pass --source-token/
--target-token), and every dry run after that plans against those snapshots
with no network and no AWS.
No file named config.json is ever committed - see .gitignore - so the
snapshots and whatever credential you put here stay on your machine.
